name: Yun's lightsaber
description: This yellow-bladed lightsaber was created by the Dark Jedi Yun. The weapon came equipped with a so-called "modified pistol grip" meaning that carefully cast projections echoed the Human hand and gave his index finger a place to rest. Not only that, but the grip was made from a highly malleable "live" polymer that explored the user's hand and morphed into a solid, highly customized grip.
